brand.name: NEXOIN
brand.personality: Modern, Reliable, Professional, Precise, Efficient, International, Technology-oriented, Premium, Minimalist
brand.logo_strategy: Typographic and minimalist, utilizing the brand font (Cabinet Grotesk). No generic trucks, roads, or delivery box icons.

theme.rationale: A dark theme elevates the brand to a premium, technology-oriented 'Awwwards' level, contrasting sharply with traditional white/blue local trucking company websites.

rules: Never use pure black #000000; stick to #070707 for depth.
Gradients should be extremely subtle or non-existent; rely on solid deep colors and 1px borders.
Accent color (#0044FF) is used strictly for critical interactions, data highlights, and the quote CTA.

headings.usage: Hero typography, section headers, massive brand reveals.

mono_accent.usage: Manifesto chapter numbers (e.g., 01, 02), metadata, small labels, button micro-copy.

rules: H1 MAX size: text-6xl md:text-8xl (exception for the 'NEXOIN' hero loader which can be massive but scaled via viewport vw).
All massive headings MUST have tracking-tighter.
Use JetBrains Mono for technical precision to establish the 'tech-startup' vibe.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.
layouts.grid_system: Asymmetrical Bento and Swiss Grid mix. Do not center everything. Use 12-column grid to offset text blocks from images.
layouts.image_treatment: Clipped frames. Images must not span 100% width edge-to-edge unless it's a specific parallax moment. Encase images in strict rectangular masks with 1px borders.

sections.hero: Kinetic typographic hero. 'NEXOIN' text massive, masked line-by-line reveal. Subtitle 'B2B TRANSPORT' in JetBrains Mono.
sections.manifesto: Numbered chapters. Huge numbers '01', '02' in JetBrains Mono with Cabinet Grotesk headings. Stark layout.
sections.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. Use Cabinet Grotesk font-light, text-4xl. Separators could be simple solid circles.
sections.services: Interactive accordion or hover-reveal grid. Minimal text until hovered.
sections.quote_devis: Dedicated page. Split screen: Left side sticky with massive typography 'REQUEST CAPACITY', Right side scrolling form.

motion.scroll: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Mandatory for premium feel.
animations: On-load: Masked line-by-line text reveal for NEXOIN using framer-motion (initial y: 100%, animate y: 0 within overflow-hidden spans).
Scroll reveals: Subtle translateY (20px) and opacity fade-in for section content.
Image parallax: Wrap images in a motion.div that translates slightly on the Y-axis based on scroll position.
Hover: Button text shifting up (staggered character animation) or simple clean scale.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle grain overlay (pointer-events-none, opacity-20) across the entire app to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid. Use border-collapse style layouts with 1px border-white/10 to create a technical blueprint feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for the sticky top navigation: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070707]/60 border-b border-white/10.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use bare HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layout to ensure maximum creative freedom. Use Shadcn ONLY for the interactive Quote/Devis form (Inputs, Select, Textarea, Button).
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). No pills. Button should look technical. Dark background with white text, or accent blue background. Include an arrow icon.
components.navigation: Sticky, transparent with backdrop-blur. Include language switcher (FR / DE / EN). 'NEXOIN' brand text on the left, Quote CTA on the right.
components.footer: Massive 'NEXOIN' text. Strict grid for links. Newsletter/contact form.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over the dark background meets 4.5:1 ratio. Gray text must not be too dark (use text-zinc-400 minimum).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all framer-motion animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='quote-submit-btn').

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth 2D/parallax reveals rather than a heavy WebGL canvas, but if 3D is strictly desired for the 'network/coverage' section, use react-globe.gl with a transparent background and monochrome blue/white dots to map European transport routes.

images.style: High contrast, desaturated, or deliberately color-graded to feel cinematic and technical. Spotlight lighting.

urls.description: Modern semi truck. Needs to be heavily filtered/darkened via CSS to fit the dark theme.
Busy shipping port under dark sky. Fits the moody, premium vibe.
Forklift in warehouse. Industrial distribution setting.

universal_guidelines: Do not use centered generic layouts. Embrace asymmetry and negative space.
NEVER translate or alter the 'NEXOIN' brand name.
Layer elements to create depth (z-index hierarchy).
Include a dedicated language switcher for FR, DE, EN.
Ensure all interactive elements have micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Provide raw JSON configurations and standard generic tailwind structures.
Do not use HTML-based native components for forms; rely on customized Shadcn.
